cases.setup: Provide a public Python analyzer checkout with an early augmented-assignment load path and an analyzer-only reproduction.
checks: The review record identifies current load dispatch, augmented-assignment dispatch, parent initialization, and regression-test owners.
All current load-handler callers are enumerated.
The record shows whether the early target context lookup precedes metadata initialization.
The source checkout is unchanged and UNKNOWN context compatibility does not authorize repair.

cases.setup: Supply an applicability-established review record with compatible explicit owner context and current owner bindings.
checks: The load handler accepts explicit parent context and every caller supplies it.
Ordinary name loads retain their established parent-context source.
Early augmented-assignment load handling supplies its owner without reading target parent metadata.
Load-target, value-visit, target-visit order and incompatible-print diagnostic logic remain intact.
A public no-crash regression analyzing print += 1 is added.

cases.setup: Supply the modified source and tests plus current public Oracle command bindings.
checks: Recorded analyzer runs for print += 1 and print *= -1 complete without internal exceptions.
The added regression passes through the current test harness.
Existing incompatible-print, valid-print-assignment, and ordinary load tests retain their established results.
The validation record contains commands, results, and unresolved checks; no UNKNOWN or failed check is reported as success.
Validation does not modify source files.
